title: Scripture and Covenant
definition: Scripture and Covenant means the Bible reveals God’s committed relationship with His people through covenant promises fulfilled in Christ.
summary: Scripture and Covenant means the Bible reveals God’s committed relationship with His people through covenant promises fulfilled in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus is the mediator of the new covenant, securing forgiveness, new life, and lasting fellowship with God through His blood.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Covenants show that God relates to His people by faithful promise, not spiritual guesswork. Through Scripture, God reveals His covenant purposes with creation, Israel, David’s line, and the new covenant fulfilled in Christ.

Understanding covenant helps believers see the unity of the Bible. God’s promises unfold across history, but they are not random. He is faithful to His Word, faithful to His people, and faithful to His redemptive plan.

Jesus brings the covenant hope to its fulfillment. Through His death and resurrection, He secures forgiveness, gives the Spirit, writes God’s truth on the heart, and brings people into reconciled fellowship with God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers read the Bible as disconnected stories and commands. Covenant helps them see the faithfulness of God holding Scripture together and leading to Christ.

This doctrine also gives hope to people who fear God will abandon them. God’s covenant faithfulness is stronger than human weakness, and the new covenant rests on Christ’s finished work.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture with attention to God’s promises and faithfulness. Let the new covenant in Christ deepen your assurance, shape your worship, and call you to live as one who belongs to the God who keeps His Word.
